verses.gurmukhi: ਗਊ ਮੁਖ ਬਾਘੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਾਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੰਗਨ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਲਈਆ ਖਗ ਮੋਹਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: guoo mukh baagh jaise base mirag maal bikhai ka(n)gan pahir jiau bilieeaa khag mohiee ||

en.bdb: Just as a lion posing cow-like innocence enters a herd of deer, or a cat deceives the birds impressing upon them that she has just returned from pilgrimage and thus holy,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਅਹਾਰ ਮੀਨ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਸਾਜਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਭਚਾਰ ਜੋਹਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bag dhiaan dhaar karat ahaar meen ganikaa si(n)gaar saaj birabhachaar johiee ||

en.bdb: Just as a heron shows himself contemplating standing on one leg in water but pounces on small fish as these come near him, a whore adores herself like married Woman and waits for a lust-filled person to visit her,

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰੋ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਜਿਉ ਸਘਾਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਤਿ ਫਾਸੀ ਡਾਰਿ ਮਾਰੈ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕਰ ਦ੍ਰੋਹਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pa(n)ch baTavaaro bhekhadhaaree jiau saghaatee hoi a(n)t faasee ddaar maarai dhroh kar dhrohiee ||

en.bdb: Just as a dacoit adopts the garb of a noble person and become a murderer and kills others with a noose around their neck, turning out to be untrusting and treacherous.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਕੈ ਮਿਲਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਾਂਸ ਗਠੀਲੋ ਨ ਬੋਹਈ ॥੨੪੦॥
verses.translit_en: kapaT saneh kai milat saadh sa(n)gat mai cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh baa(n)s gaTheelo na bohiee ||240||

en.bdb: Similarly, if a person with mock and fake love comes to the company of saintly persons, he does not acquire or assimilate the good influence of the holy congregation, just as a knotted bamboo tree acquire no fragrance despite growing in the near proximity of a Sandalwood tree. (240)
